title: NZ Tech-for-Good directory entry
description: One organisation, project, or network in the Aotearoa New Zealand tech-for-good directory.

name.description: The organisation, project, or network's name.

domain.description: The area of public good this entry works in. Reuse an existing domain where it fits.
enum: health tech for good / hauora Māori

what.description: One or two plain-language sentences describing what it does and why it matters.

region.description: The NZ region it's based in, or "national".

website.description: Its main website URL, or an empty string if none.

github.description: Its GitHub org/repo URL, or an empty string if none.

linkedin_org.description: Its LinkedIn company page URL, or an empty string if none.

linkedin_people.description: Relevant people connected to this entry, if any is publicly known and on file.

tags.description: A short list of descriptive tags.

related_to.description: Other entries' `name` values this one is meaningfully connected to (only real, verifiable connections).

source.description: How the entry was verified (e.g. which page was fetched, and how).

founding_year.description: The year the organisation or project was founded, if known. Leave null if not verified.

takes_contributors.description: Whether the organisation is known to take outside contributors or volunteers. Leave null if not verified.

careers_url.description: A careers or volunteering page URL, or an empty string if none on file.

last_verified.description: The date (YYYY-MM-DD) this entry's details were last checked against a live source.
